primary_comparisons.endpoint_interpretation: agreement with blinded AI reference labels, not independently validated physical correctness
primary_comparisons.holm_missing_test_policy: Unavailable primary tests occupy a prespecified family slot with p=1; no test family is shrunk.

matching.AI_reference_eligibility: Per-record eligible morphology/domain scopes filter both predictions and gold. Unqualified types receive neither credit nor penalty; empty scope produces unavailable metrics and cannot select a primary comparator.
matching.ridge_tolerance: max(minimum tolerance, 2Hz from the shared 1Hz assessment grid, reference frequency uncertainty); model-declared bins cannot relax acceptance
matching.optional_synthetic_events: Known optional beat-envelope harmonics give neither TP credit nor FP/FN penalty.
matching.modulation_scope: Synthetic modulation is scored only for am_noise, beating, mixed, noise and silence. For truth.modulation_exhaustive=false, modulation predictions and references are excluded without credit or penalty.
matching.time_uncertainty: Temporal IoU rule is fixed; stated boundary uncertainty is retained in annotations, not silently used to enlarge boxes.

grouping.rule: connected components of shared parent provenance within each stratum

interpretation: Real and real-mixture scores measure agreement with AI references, not independently validated physical correctness.
The distinct annotation checkpoints share Qwen-family language backbones; blind passes are not statistically independent and correlated errors remain possible.
Unmatched predictions in disputed or unreviewed real regions are disagreements with the reference set, not certified false positives.
Exact synthetic metrics apply only to the declared generator and cannot validate real source identity.
Schema/model failures remain in all applicable denominators as unsuccessful or empty reports.
Data strata are never pooled into a headline accuracy value.
No free-text claim fidelity or calibrated probability score is inferred from the verifier.
Repeated frozen deterministic generations do not establish independent model-seed variability.
